entities.label: Aaron Booker Files Amended Complaint Against Bronson Kitchen
entities.description: On November 9, 2026, Aaron Booker filed an amended complaint with a jury demand in federal case 1:26-cv-00221-DBP. The court docket lists the filing as ECF No. 6 and records that the City of American Fork was terminated as a defendant under the amended complaint.

entities.label: Aaron Booker Files Lawsuit Against City of American Fork

descriptionParagraphs.text: filed a federal lawsuit against the City of American Fork and other defendants on November 2, 2026, according to filing information he provided directly to AFPD Accountability.
Booker v. City of American Fork et al.
The lawsuit follows Booker’s traffic stop by American Fork Detective
over an alleged HOV-lane violation. Kitchen later apologized for the stop and his handling of the encounter.

During the City Council’s August 11, 2026 Truth in Taxation hearing, Booker criticized the department’s response, disputed statements in the incident report, and said he intended to pursue a civil-rights lawsuit. His comments are documented on
page 3 of the corrected hearing minutes
Booker’s filing brings the number of current lawsuits against the City tracked by AFPD Accountability to three. The other two are
Thorpe et al. v. Cedar Hills City et al.
Norcross et al. v. City of American Fork et al.
